answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks fakes: an agent earns full rewards only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 3 epochs, at most 2 from one cluster. A garden needs many plants, not one juniper cutting cloned endlessly; sybils merely echo each other's trades and fail. Making 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 partners at 20 units locked 20 epochs, costing 240,000 units, while an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps undiluted rewards.
